_why: The premade build reaches Bladework and Hemorrhage but misses the talent
that feeds them, and takes Heightened Senses at half strength. Everything
bought here is part of one loop -- dodge:
Ghostly Strike 1/1      (T2.1) a combo builder granting 15% dodge for 20
seconds. The premade build does not take it at
all, which leaves the three talents below with
no input.
Heightened Senses 2/2   (T4.0, was 1/2) dodging restores health. This is
Subtlety's entire solo sustain and it was running
at half rate.
Dirty Tricks 1/1        (T1.1) Ambush and Backstab no longer require
being behind the target. One point that removes
a positioning requirement a bot fighting a boss
alone cannot reliably satisfy.
Enveloping Shadows 3/3  (T6.0) finishers proc full-strength Slice and
Dice and Expose Armor. Bladework is the finisher
now and it is pressed at every full combo bar,
so this fires constantly.
Dodge is simultaneously the mitigation, the healing and a damage
multiplier here: Bladework counters attacks it *dodges or parries* as well
as ones that land, and self-cast Tricks of the Trade adds dodge worth a
fifth of the rogue's critical strike chance. Filthy Tricks stays at 1/2 --
it cuts Tricks of the Trade's cost and cooldown, which matters more now
that it is a rotational buff, but not enough to outbid the four above.
Funded by:
Honor Among Thieves 3/3  combo points from *party members'* critical
strikes. Worth exactly nothing alone, and the
single largest dead block in the premade build.
Vile Poisons 1/3 and Improved Poisons 4/5 -> 2/5  three points out of the
Assassination dip's bottom row, which has nothing
below it and so cannot break a prerequisite.
54 Subtlety / 17 Assassination.
